summary: Go SDK compliance package: how it moves to the control model of the reference

options.description: Replace with the reference model in one 0.x release, with a release note
Add the reference model beside the old one and deprecate the old one
Remove the compliance package from the Go SDK
Keep the Go model and exempt it from parity

body: Problem: the Go SDK compliance package uses its own data model, which differs from the reference (10 AI-SDLC controls, 40 framework references). Moving to the reference model breaks the Go API. Ruling: replace it in one 0.x release with the reference model, with a release note.
